patthana23.45:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassana appaṭigho pītisahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.45:2.1: na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ na sukhasahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassana appaṭigho sukhasahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.45:3.1: na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ na upekkhāsahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassana appaṭigho upekkhāsahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi. na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ na dassanena
